purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for import/export jobs, source/target identities, profiles, semantic diffs, conflicts, lossiness and roundtrip evidence.

topics.name: Import/Export Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for import/export jobs, source/target identities, profiles, semantic diffs, conflicts, lossiness and roundtrip evidence.

semantics.identity_rule: Source, target, import/export job and serialized artifact identities remain separate.
semantics.action_rule: Import/export/retry/reconcile operations invoke separate authorized commands.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing transfer jobs grants no read/write authority beyond monitor scope.
semantics.redaction_rule: Sensitive exported/imported values may be redacted according to policy.
semantics.trace_rule: Job results retain exact source/target/profile/hash/diff refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Lossy/conflicted/failed jobs are displayed explicitly and never as successful equivalent backups.

invariants.rule: Import/export families resolve exact source/target identities and explicit serialization profiles; conversion never silently changes semantic ownership, identity or authority.

hard_gates.condition: lossy export displayed as equivalent backup
